headline: Day 18 usage reset announced
originalTimeText: Landing tomorrow before 10am PST together with a small ship.
scope: Day 18 usage reset and a small update expected before October 23, 10am PST.

announcement.text: Day 18/ Decisions API is GA, OpenResponses joined the Linux Foundation, we shipped some performance improvements and Uber is going all-in on codex & work. But yes… that’s a reset!
announcement.translation: 第 18 天：Decisions API 已正式可用，OpenResponses 加入了 Linux 基金会，我们发布了一些性能改进，Uber 正全面采用 Codex 与 Work。没错……又是一次额度重置！

timingSource.text: Landing tomorrow before 10am PST together with a small ship.
timingSource.translation: 将在明天 PST 上午 10 点前落地，同时还会有一项小更新。

note: Day 18 is a new reset announcement, separate from the landed Day 17 reset. The reply was posted on October 22 in Pacific time, so tomorrow means October 23 there. The countdown uses literal PST: October 23, 18:00 UTC / October 24, 02:00 UTC+8. If PST meant PDT, the deadline is one hour earlier. The small update was not described; eligible plans and usage windows were not specified.
